name: Maui Moala
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Maui Moala is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 42, she has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a demolitions expert out of Glassway, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Maui Moala operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Fatoumata Delgado-Opoku once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: Fatoumata Delgado-Opoku discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Fatoumata Delgado-Opoku intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A corporate black site Fatoumata Delgado-Opoku once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Fatoumata Delgado-Opoku represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander (50.6%) forms the primary ancestry base, creating broad facial structure and natural bone geometry. Significant Hispanic/Latin American (32.6%) ancestry adds warmth and fullness to facial features. Indigenous American (11.5%) ancestry contributes to cheekbone prominence and hair texture characteristics. Sub-Saharan African (5.3%) ancestry enriches skin undertones and adds subtle depth to overall coloration. The combination creates a striking phenotype: broad, well-defined facial structure with fullness through the face and jaw, warm golden-amber skin tone with reddish undertones that luminously blend all ancestral components, and natural wave and thickness in hair texture reflecting Pacific and Indigenous heritage.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with defined musculature — ropy rather than bulky. Shoulders slightly asymmetrical from years of carrying heavy ordnance loads. Center of gravity naturally low, built for agility rather than raw power.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silvered streaks at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. Rarely loose. Practical to the point of severity.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm bronze with golden-amber undertones — the blend of Pacific Islander, Hispanic/Latin American, Indigenous American, and Sub-Saharan African heritage creates a luminous, sun-kissed finish. Darkened from outdoor work into a rich caramel-bronze with subtle reddish undertones in direct light.
physical_description.complexion: Broad, well-defined cheekbones characteristic of Pacific Islander and Indigenous American ancestry, with fullness through the face and jaw. Angular mandible softened by the structural width of Pacific Islander heritage. Minimal grooming beyond functionality — a faint scar at the left temple from shrapnel. Crow's feet pronounced for her age from squinting at precise work. Lips full and usually pressed into a neutral line. Skin weathered but not damaged, marked by chemical burns on the inside of her left forearm (acid exposure from early ordnance work). Nose broad and straight, reflecting the diverse ancestry blend.
distinguishing_marks: Shrapnel scar at left temple, approximately 3cm, pale and slightly depressed into the skin
Chemical burn marks on inner left forearm — discolored patches of lighter skin, concentrated around wrist and medial arm
Tattoo on right shoulder blade: a detonator symbol (concentric circles with timing marks), professional and precisely inked in black
Surgical scar at base of skull where neural jack protrudes — visible between braid sections, metallic junction point gleaming
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome neural interface jack at base of skull — 2cm square mounting plate, dark metallic, slightly protruding. No active LEDs. Hydraulic joint servos visible as faint chrome plating at elbows and knees under bare skin — industrial sheen breaks the natural texture slightly, particularly visible under fluorescent light or when limbs are in motion.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight distributed toward the balls of her feet, ready to pivot or bolt. Head slightly forward, eyes tracking. Resting jaw tension suggests active calculation. When still, her fingers tap an irregular rhythm against her thigh — a kinetic stim that never quite stops. Walks fast even when there's no hurry.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical runner aesthetic. Reinforced charcoal synthcotton cargo pants with multiple pockets (keys, detonators, encrypted data spools). Steel-toed boots, scuffed and re-sealed. Loose-fit dark jacket in cracked-finish ballistic nylon — oversized to conceal ordnance-related lumps and allow arm mobility. Under-layer is a fitted black compression shirt with cooling channels printed into the fabric. No logos or corp affiliation. Jewelry limited to a worn steel wrist-cuff (custom-made, likely houses a micro-timer or range-finder tool). Her entire wardrobe reads as someone who prioritizes function over fashion, maintenance over aesthetics.
